rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: Das Überdruckventil hat unter %s ausgeblasen. Steht die Anzeige am Anschlag, runter vom Gitter.
rows.back: The pressure relief valve discharged beneath %s. If the indicator is at its limit, get off the grate.
rows.back_notes: 'Unter %s' can mean beneath %s or under a condition represented by %s. 'Ausgeblasen' describes blowing or discharging, without specifying what was discharged.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.
rows.msgstr: Noch kein Checkpoint. Gespeichert wird ab dem ersten SICHERUNGSPUNKT.
rows.back: No checkpoint yet. Saving begins at the first SAVE POINT.
rows.back_notes: 'Sicherungspunkt' can also mean a securing or safety point.

rows.msgid: The Director thinks WOLF is still in standby.
rows.msgstr: Der Direktor glaubt, WOLF sei noch im Standby.
rows.back: The Director believes WOLF is still in standby.
rows.back_notes: 'Der Direktor' is masculine.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.
rows.msgstr:
Niemand gibt einen Aktivierungsbefehl.
WOLF weckt sich selbst.
rows.back:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself up.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
rows.msgstr:
Der Wächter hat %s im Freien gesehen.
Bleib nah am TANKAUSLÖSER.
rows.back:
The guard saw %s outdoors.
Stay close to the TANK TRIGGER.
rows.back_notes: 'Der Wächter' is masculine. 'Im Freien' specifically means outdoors. 'Tankauslöser' does not specify what action the trigger causes.
'Anzeige' can mean a display, indicator or readout.

rows.back: Go right to the circuit breaker.

rows.msgid: Or head right to the breaker.

rows.back: Or go right to the circuit breaker.

rows.back_notes: Names a technical field or function, not an individual technician.
'Versorgung' can refer to power, utilities or other supplies.
Can mean repeat or retry, depending on what is being repeated.

rows.msgid: E: read the Director's purge display.
rows.back: E: Read the Director's purge display.
rows.back_notes: 'Säuberung' can mean cleaning, cleansing or a purge. 'Direktor' is masculine.

rows.msgid: HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.
rows.msgstr: HALTEN E: manuellen Bypass kurbeln, %d von %d.
rows.back: HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.
rows.back_notes: 'HALTEN E' has unnatural German word order for a hold-key instruction.

rows.back: E: Talk with WOLF about the relay.
rows.back_notes: 'Über das Relais' can mean about the relay or via the relay.

rows.msgid: Find the breaker. WOLF will follow your lead.

rows.back: Find the circuit breaker. WOLF follows you.

rows.back: The Director believes WOLF is still waiting.
rows.back_notes: 'En espera' can mean waiting, on hold or on standby. 'El Director' is masculine.

rows.msgid:

WOLF wakes himself.
rows.msgstr:
Nadie da una orden de activación.
WOLF se despierta solo.
rows.back:
Nobody gives an activation order.
WOLF wakes up by himself.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
rows.msgstr:
El centinela vio a %s al descubierto.
Quédate cerca de SOLTAR TANQUE.
rows.back:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to RELEASE TANK.
rows.back_notes: 'El centinela' is grammatically masculine. 'SOLTAR TANQUE' is an action label used awkwardly as a location; 'soltar' can mean release, let go of or drop.

rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: %sの足元でリリーフベントが噴き出した。ゲージが振り切れたら、格子から離れること。
rows.back: The relief vent erupted at %s's feet. If the gauge goes off the scale, move away from the grating.
rows.back_notes: The wording makes the vent itself the subject of 'erupted'; it leaves the discharged substance unstated.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.
rows.msgstr: チェックポイントはまだない。最初のセーフポイントから保存される。

rows.back: The head of the facility thinks WOLF is still in standby mode.
rows.back_notes: '所長' means the head of a facility or institution; it is not gendered.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.

誰も起動命令を出していない。
WOLFは自ら目を覚ます。

Nobody has issued a startup command.
WOLF wakes up of his own accord.
rows.back_notes: The source does not specify gender.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.

セントリーが開けた場所にいる%sを見つけた。
タンク投下の近くにいること。

The sentry found %s in an open area.
Stay near the tank drop.
rows.back_notes: 'タンク投下' names dropping a tank, not explicitly a control or location. 'Tank' could refer to a container or an armored vehicle.

rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: Сорвало предохранительный клапан, а %s — прямо на решётке. Когда стрелка манометра на пределе, не стой на решётке.
rows.back: The safety valve was blown off, and %s is right on the grate. When the pressure gauge needle is at the limit, don't stand on the grate.

rows.back_notes: Директор is a masculine title.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.

Никто не отдаёт команду на активацию.

WOLF wakes up on his own.

rows.back:
The guard noticed: %s is out in the open.
Stay closer to the “TANK RESET” control panel.
rows.back_notes: Страж and заметил are masculine. Сброс бака is ambiguous: it could refer to draining, dumping, releasing, or resetting the tank.
